book.name: Markas
book.title: Khoes khabar djaise Markas liekhies hai

content: Bhoet-paret ke aadmie
Tab sabhan samoendar kaatke Geraasa log ke des me pahoetj gail.
Djaise Jiesoe bot me se niekaral, taise kabarsthaan me se ekgo aadmie okar lage aail. Oke bhoet pakaries raha,
aur oe pahaar ke hol me rahat raha djaaha maral manai logan ke mattie parat raha. Aur koi na oke pakarke baanh paawat raha.
Oesab kai dafe okar haath gor ketie se baanhies raha, bakie oe ketie toer dhaarat raha. Koi na oke samhaar paawat raha.
Oe raat dien pahaar par aur kabarsthaan me dawwaat raha. Oe hardam tjiellaat raha aur apane ke patthar se maarat raha.
Tab djab oe Jiesoe ke doer me dekhies, tab dhaurke aail aur okar gore gier paral.

Tab Jiesoe bolies: „Bhoet-paret, ie aadmie me se bhaag dja!” Tab oe tjiellaaike bolies: „Jiesoe! Toe sab se maahaan Parmeswar ke Beta baate! Tose aur hamse kaun kaam hai? Parmeswar ke naam se ham tose maangiela kie toe hamme piera na deihe.”
Tab oe poetjhies: „Tor ka naam hai?” Tab oe bolies: „Hamaar naam Dher hai. Hamlog dher djane se baatie.”
Oe ose bientie karies: „Hamlogke hia se doer na khaderiehe.”
Hoewa par ek djhoend soewar pahaar par tjarat raha, lagbhag doei hadjaar.
Tab bhoet-paret log Jiesoe se bientie karies: „Hamlogke soewarwan me djaain de.”
Tab oe bolies: „Dja!” Bhoet log aadmie me se niekarke gail soewar ke oeppar phaat paral. Tab djhoend bhar pahaar par se dhaure lagal aur samoendar me gierke doebke mar gail.
Tab soewar ke tjaraawe waalan bhaag gail sahar aur gaaw me sab koi se bataawe ke. Tab dher manai log aail dekhe kie ka howe hai.
Tab djab oesab Jiesoe lage aail tab dekhies kie bhoet-paret waala aadmie sadhaaran se baithal hai aur kapra pahienies hai aur okar moerie thiek hoi gail. Tab oesab ghabaraai gail.
Tab djaun aadmie log sab tjiedj dekhies raha, oesab bataais Jiesoe kaise bhoet-paret log ke bhagaais aur soewar log se ka bhail.
Tab hoewa ke manai logan Jiesoe se bientie karies kie: „Toe hia se bestar tjal dja.”
Tab djab Jiesoe bot me gail, tab aadmie djaun attjha hoi gail raha, oe bolies: „Ham maangiela tor sanghe djaai.”
Bakie oe bolies: „Toe dja ghare aapan palwaar lage. Aur sabhan se bataihe kie Prabhoe daaja karke tore khaat kaun biesaal kaam karies hai.”
Aadmie tjal gail aur Dekaapoles galie me sab koi se bataawe lagal kie Jiesoe kaun barka kaam karies hai. Aur sab koi moeh baaike soenat raha.
Jaairas ke bietia aur bemaar aurat
Tab Jiesoe aur okar tjela log phieno samoendar ke habara kaaties. Tab oke pahoetjat der na lagal aur dher manai okar lage aail. Ohie khaatien oe samoendar lage rahie gail.
Tab ekgo aadmie aage aail. Oe ek partjaar ke ghar ke barkwa raha, aur okar naam Jaairas raha. Tab djab oe Jiesoe ke dekhies, tab okar gore gieral,
aur bientie karies kie: „Hamaar bietia mare par atkal hai. Ham bahoet maangiela kie toe aaike aapan haath okar oeppar dharieho. Tab oe batj djaai.”
Tab Jiesoe okar sanghe tjale lagal. Aur dher manai oke thelat-thaalat djaat raha.
Oman bhie ekgo aurat raha. Oke baara baries lek khaalie khoen gierat raha.
Oe dher daaktar ke lage gail raha aur oesab oke bahoet doekh katwaais raha. Oe aapan sab paisa oman laga deis raha, bakie tabbo aur kharaab hoi gail raha.

Oe Jiesoe ke baare me soenies raha kie oe kaun barka kaam kare hai. Tab oe apane me sotjies: „Djab ham khaalie okar kapra tjhoei leb tab ham attjha hoi djaabe.” Tab oe sab manai ke thelat-thaalat Jiesoe ke paatjhe gail aur okar kapra tjhoei leis.
Ohie laage khoen ekdam se band hoi gail. Oe djaan gail kie oe attjha hoi gail hai.
Jiesoe toerant djaan gail kie okar saktie kaam me lewal gail hai. Tab oe ghoemke poetjhies: „Hamaar kapra ke tjhoeis hai?”
Tab okar tjela log bolies: „Toe to dekhe hai manai log kaise dhakele hai. Tab toe kaise ie poetjh sake hai?”
Bakie oe taakies kie ke oke tjhoeis hai.
Tab aurat dar ke maare kaape lagal aur aage gail. Oe djaanat raha kie okar sanghe ka bhail hai. Tab oe Jiesoe ke gore gierke sab tjiedj bataais.
Tab oe bolies: „Betie, toe hamare me bieswaas karle hai, ohie se toe batj gaile. Attjha se djaihe aur tjangga rahiehe.”
Abbe oe batiaite raha tab barkwa ke ek ghar waala aail aur aapan sardaar se bolies: „Tor bietia mar gail. Ab maastar djie ke moesiebat na de.”
Bakie Jiesoe ie baat par dhiaan na lagaais. Oe barkwa se bolies: „Na ghabara, khaalie hamare me bieswaas kar.”
Oe na maangat raha kie dher manai okar saath djaai. Oe khaalie Petras, Jaakobas aur okar bhaai Johaanas ke legail.
Djab sabhan barkwa ke ghar lage pahoetjal tab Jiesoe dekhies kie hoewa ke manai log oedaasie ke maare piet-pietke rowe hai.
Tab Jiesoe aur ekwan bhiettar gail aur bolies: „Oe larkie na maral hai, oe soete hai. Toelog etana na row.”
Tab sabhan oke hase lagal. Bakie oe sab koi ke bahare karies. Tab oe maai baap aur tieno tjela log ke leike larkie ke kamra me gail.
Oe maral larkie ke haath pakarke bolies: „Taalieta koem!” Ekar matlab hai: „Betie, ham tose boliela: Oethke thara how!”
Aur larkie toerant thara hoike tjale lagal. Oe baara baries ke raha. Okar maai baap aur tjela log dekhke bahoet atjambho bhail!
Tab Jiesoe oelogke mienaahie karies kie: „Koi se na bataaw kie kaun tjiedj bhail hai.” Oe bhie bolies: „Koetjh khaaik oke dei de.”
